authoring_decisions.statement: Author exactly one L03 OPI item from the eligible position-1 bounded source artifact.
Preserve VALI KE and PARAZAMI KE as the complete closed parallel authored source package with no preferred realization.
Move exactly one L03 curriculum slot from MISSING to AUTHORED and do not validate it in this gate.
Create no canonical OPI ID or label and preserve selector 1 as NONCANONICAL_STRUCTURAL_INDEX_ONLY.
If approved, open only a separate position-1 OPI validation-strategy gate and stop.

governance_decisions.statement: OPI authoring is curriculum authoring only and does not promote lexical or grammar authority.
No subject/person, tense/aspect, copula or natural-language translation semantics are introduced or inferred.
No universal L03/HNK interrogative grammar or question-to-declarative derivation is created.
VALI FROZEN, PARAZAMI WATCH and KE non-generalization remain unchanged.
DARUNO/NELARA parent lexeme gate and HNK3000 remain untouched.
A future SIGA may approve only this position-1 OPI authoring application while this gate remains active.
